rules: A decision counts once. Probe case ids are unique across decisions; the control is an in-family Completed case. Outcome = toolResponded status (or no-response), errorText substring, submitCount, re-checked on a fresh reproduced receipt. Source = token present in lines [a,b] of the retained decoded body whose sha256 appears in the cited SOURCES row anchor.
